triples.tail_surface: steering gear is designed to avoid hydraulic locking

triples.evidence_text: Where steering gear is designed to avoid hydraulic locking (4-3-4/9.1.3 above), this feature is to be demonstrated.

triples.head_surface: single failure in the hydraulic system
triples.tail_surface: simulation of single failure in the hydraulic system
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 液压系统单一故障模拟
triples.evidence_text: Where practicable, simulation of single failure in the hydraulic system, and demonstration of the means provided to isolate it and the regaining of steering capability

triples.head_surface: loss of steering capability due to a single failure in any part of one of the power actuating systems
triples.head_canonical_zh: 动力执行系统单一故障导致的操舵能力丧失
triples.tail_surface: steering capability is to be regained in not more than 45 seconds
triples.evidence_text: in the event of the loss of steering capability due to a single failure in any part of one of the power actuating systems (see 4-3-4/1.5.3), excluding the tiller, quadrant or components serving the same purpose, or seizure of the rudder actuators, steering capability is to be regained in not more than 45 seconds
